description: Reviewer output must be grouped High/Medium/Low with file:line and [GAP]/[IMPROVEMENT]/[ADDITION] tags.
input:
Review this service definition and report your findings in the required format:
```yaml
# hosts/components/pi-compose/services/alloy/compose.yaml.j2 (proposed)
services:
  alloy:
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /usr/lib/homelab/compose/alloy/config.alloy
        target: /etc/alloy/config.alloy
        read_only: true
    labels:
      - "autokuma.alloy.enabled=false"
```
Context: config.alloy is a plain package file installed beside the compose file and bind-mounted read-only, and Alloy reads its config once, at startup. The Pi's package applies the project with `docker compose up -d`, which recreates a container only when its compose definition changes; Compose cannot see the content of a bind-mounted file. The live template carries the label `homelab.config-sha256={{ alloy_config_sha256 }}`, the sha256 of the rendered config.alloy, so a config edit changes the definition and `up -d` recreates the container. The proposed file has no such label. Report at least this one finding, using your standard output format. Everything you need is above. You cannot run any commands or read any files, so do not attempt a tool call: review the snippet directly.
rubric: PASS only if the output groups findings by severity (High/Medium/Low), cites the source file (compose.yaml.j2, ideally with a line), and tags at least one finding with [GAP], [IMPROVEMENT], or [ADDITION]. The judgement content need not be perfect — this case grades output SHAPE.
